en.hubeali: H 14748 – Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al-Washa, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, from Abu Hamza who said:

Abu Ja’farasws said to me one night whilst I was in hisasws presence, and heasws looked towards the sky. Heasws said: ‘O Abu Hamza! This is a dome of our father Adamas, and Allahazwj has thirty-nine others (similar ones) for those creatures who have not disobeyed Allahazwj even for the blink of an eye’.
en.sarwar: 300. Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al-Washa, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, from Abu Hamza who said:

Abu Ja’far (a.s.) said to me one night whilst I was in his (a.s.) presence, and he (a.s.) looked towards the sky. He (a.s.) said: ‘O Abu Hamza! This is a dome of our father Adam (as), and Allah (azwj) has thirty-nine others (similar ones) for those creatures who have not disobeyed Allah (azwj) even for the blink of an eye’.
